episode_title: Democratic Surrogates Campaign, US & Israel Plan Iran Strikes, Tesla SpaceX Merger
script_en: Democratic Surrogates Campaign, US & Israel Plan Iran Strikes, Tesla SpaceX Merger.
Democrats are sending former President Barack Obama and former Vice President Kamala Harris into competitive Senate races to help the party win in Republican territory.
and Israel are preparing for a possible attack on Iran after the midterms, while Americans face settler violence and military arrests in the West Bank.
